verdict.rationale: Generating or editing workflows from a prompt is a fair axis for a workflow automation tool, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents an AI workflow builder or prompt-to-workflow feature in n8n. The 'Convert natural language into API calls' item describes a use case users can build inside a workflow, and the template library and LLM integrations are adjacent features; neither generates or edits workflows from a prompt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can generate or edit a workflow from a natural-language prompt
